user.title: USCCB Daily Readings
user.description: This integration loads English daily Mass readings from the official USCCB RSS feed. No account or API key is required.

data_description.expose_full_text: Include complete Scripture readings in sensor attributes for authorized use in dashboards, automations, notifications, and text-to-speech. Scripture text remains subject to applicable copyright and USCCB usage permissions; enabling this option does not by itself grant permission.
